configuration.description: Shows all instances of the team that the current user is connected to via an active connection.
configuration.fetchxml: <fetch version="1.0" output-format="xml-platform" mapping="logical" distinct="true" savedqueryid="a596ff84-88fd-4eea-84f6-335b357e176a"><entity name="team"><attribute name="name" /><attribute name="businessunitid" /><attribute name="teamid" /><attribute name="teamtype" /><filter type="and"><condition attribute="teamtype" operator="ne" value="1" /></filter><order attribute="name" descending="false" /><link-entity name="connection" from="record2id" to="teamid" alias="MyConnections"><filter type="and"><condition attribute="record1id" operator="eq-userid" /><condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0" /></filter></link-entity></entity></fetch>

layoutxml.xmlWithLogicalObject: <grid name="teams" object="logical:team" jump="name" select="1" icon="1" preview="1"><row name="team" id="teamid"><cell name="name" width="300" /><cell name="businessunitid" width="100" /></row></grid>

configuration.name: My Connections
configuration.offlinesqlquery: /*SelectStart*/select   DISTINCT  "team0".[name] as "name" , "team0".[businessunitid!id] as "businessunitid!id" , "team0".[businessunitid!logicalname] as "businessunitid!logicalname" , "team0".[businessunitid!name] as "businessunitid!name" , "team0".[teamid] as "teamid" , "team0".[teamtype] as "teamtype"/*SelectEnd*/  /*FromStart*/from  Team as "team0" 	/*JoinStart*/ join Connection as "MyConnections" on ("team0".[teamid]  =  "MyConnections".[record2id!id] and ("MyConnections".[record1id!id] = "!eq-userid!" and "MyConnections".[statecode] = 0))/*JoinEnd*//*FromEnd*/  /*WhereStart*/where  (("team0".[teamtype] != 1 or "team0".[teamtype] is null))/*WhereEnd*/  /*OrderByStart*/order by  "team0".[name] asc/*OrderByEnd*/
